messages:
devon: Noticed a spike in short-pod SIGTERMs in ap-southeast1b at ~02:13 UTC. Looks like pods die during prebind. Anyone else seeing this?
maria: I see it too. schedule_attempt_duration P95 jumped. Posting grafana: https://grafana/reports/sched/apse1b
aj: Traces show scheduler prebind step hanging ~30-45s for a subset of nodes in pool-7c, then pods evicted mid-start.
sophia: Any kubelet errors?
devon: kubelet logs show repeated apiserver connection timeouts and binding timeout events. Snippet: ```Warning PreBind failed: binding timeout after 30s```
kyle: Could be control-plane egress for that AZ. Did we have any NLB logs?
aj: Cloud provider shows brief SNAT exhaustion/egress spike for nodes in pool-7c for ~30s. Correlates with the timeline.
maria: Quick mitigation idea: increase scheduler prebind timeout to 60s for ap-southeast1 canary. Less evictions for short-lived pods. Rollback if backlog appears.
sophia: Works for immediate relief, but we should avoid masking root cause. Also notify CS about impacted customers and include a note about retries.
kyle: Also add an alert: schedule_queue_length > 40 for 3m AND apiserver_request_duration_seconds P95 > 1s -> page oncall.
aj: I'll open an RFC for safer prebind/backoff behavior and to avoid evicting pods stuck in bind window during transient control-plane issues. Link in thread after created.
devon: Action items: @maria apply canary patch (60s), @aj write RFC, @kyle add alert, infra-bot file incident ticket.
infra-bot: Incident 2026-03-apse1b-009 created and attached to thread.
maria: Canary applied to 5 nodes, monitoring.
devon: Initial canary shows reduced SIGTERMs. Hold 20m then roll wider if stable.
sophia: Thanks team, I'll update CS and log timeline. Follow-up: open cloud provider ticket for SNAT/egress spike root cause.
